item.content:encoded:
The 9th KIPPRA Annual Regional Conference
The 9th KIPPRA Annual Regional Conference convened critical conversations on Strengthening Value Chains for Inclusive Growth in Kenya, bringing together policymakers, researchers, development partners, private sector actors and other stakeholders to chart pathways for inclusive and sustainable development.
The Conference Communiqué highlights the participants declarations.
KIPPRA (Amendment) Bill, 2026
The Kenya Institute for Public Policy Research and Analysis (KIPPRA) Amendment Bill and is now open for public participation, and your views matter
The Kenya Economic Report 2025
The Kenya Economic Report 2025 themed Creating Decent Jobs for Prosperity has an overarching goal of presenting evidence-based public policy options that can create decent jobs for prosperity in Kenya by boosting productivity across various sectors.
Kenya Fiscal Incidence Analysis (KFIA) Report
The report, Poverty and Distributional Impacts of
Fiscal Policy in Kenya: A Commitment to Equity
Assessment with Extensions to Gender and
Children, presents a significant milestone in the use of robust analytical tools to inform inclusive policies in Kenya.

item.content:encoded:
The Institute of Policy Analysis and Research (IPAR) is an independent, indigenous and non-partisan private organisation established in 1994. It is a non-profit body mandated to conduct databased social science policy analysis and research, and training, with the aim of improving human welfare. IPAR shares its policy findings with the government of Kenya, its development partners, private sector, and civil society.

Call for Papers
The Institute of Policy Analysis and Research (IPAR) is an independent, indigenous and non-partisan private organisation established in 1994. It is a non-profit body mandated to conduct evidence-based social science policy analysis and research and training, with the aim of improving human welfare. IPAR shares its policy findings with the government of Kenya, its development partners, private sector and the civil society.
IPAR is inviting papers for presentation during the Think Workshop.
